steps: Name the spacing scale before the first margin

items.caption:
Eleven blues across one product. Not a design failure — nobody had ever written down which blue was the blue.

#DesignSystems #Frontend #CaseStudy

props.before: Eleven hex values, all approximately correct
actions: Count the distinct values already shipping
Name the four that actually earn a place
Fail the build when a raw hex appears
props.lesson: A system is enforced or it is a suggestion.

items.caption:

#DesignSystems #ProductDesign #Frontend

props.headline: Four signs a system is real
items: New screens get built faster than before
Nobody asks which grey to use
The code and the file agree on names
Changing a token changes the product

#BuildInPublic #ContentStrategy #Remotion

props.lesson: The dull weekly habit beat every clever idea.

items.caption:
What thirty days of daily video actually cost us, honestly. Most of it was not the making.

#Founder #BuildInPublic #ContentStrategy

moments: The making was the easy part
Deciding what to say took longer
Week three is where it nearly stopped
props.turn: We built the pipeline so week three could not stop it.
props.lesson: Automate the part that fails when you are tired.

items.caption:
How the whole series was made: one React component per format, everything else is data and a scheduled job.

#Remotion #Automation #WebDev

props.hook: How this series was actually made
steps: Every video is one React component and one JSON row
Music is synthesised per video, never reused
Rendering runs in parallel on a schedule
props.result: Writing the script is the only manual step left.
